description: SKILL: true long-run edge (0-10) — small per-event, compounds over volume
VOLUME: tournaments in the sample (variance washes out with volume)
VARIANCE: average field size (bigger = more top-heavy = more variance)
MANAGEMENT: starting bankroll measured in buy-ins (drives risk of ruin)
In-the-money rate over the sample (%) — near the paid fraction, weak skill signal
Final-table rate (%) — a better skill signal than ITM
Outright win rate (%) — tiny even for the skilled
Largest single cash in buy-ins (deep-run luck)
Ending bankroll in buy-ins (0 if broke)
TARGET (regression): realized ROI over the sample (%)
TARGET (binary): 1 if the bankroll hit zero (risk of ruin)
